verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an email-marketing SaaS that stores subscriber data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion endpoints, or account/contact data purge. It shows only update and upsert operations and a generic claim about helping meet privacy standards, none of which is a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
